gaps.sentence: She wore ___ heels to the party.
gaps.explanation: 'High heels' is the fixed collocation; 'tall' is used for people, buildings and trees.

gaps.sentence: The new tax law will ___ every small business in the region.
gaps.explanation: 'Affect' is the verb (to influence); 'effect' is normally the noun.

gaps.sentence: One of the screws on the bracket has come ___.
The book gives a detailed ___ account of the period.
gaps.hint: connected with the study of the past
gaps.explanation: 'Historical' means relating to history or the past; 'historic' means important in history.
'Besides' means in addition to; 'beside' means next to; 'except' means not including.
'Valuable' means worth a lot of money; 'valued' means appreciated; 'invaluable' already means priceless, so it is not graded.

gaps.sentence: I was so ___ when I forgot her name in front of everyone.
gaps.hint: how you feel in an awkward social situation
gaps.explanation: 'Embarrassed' describes short-term discomfort in a social situation; 'ashamed' implies guilt about wrongdoing.
